properties.name: Increment 3 measured on 0.94.0: full design 25/25, 12 KB with the kit's cue 16/25 (pilot hand cue 17.5, notes 14.5), 12 KB uncued 3/25; in-reply cues still followed within 5 calls only 3.8%
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-10-30, increment 3 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory, against the predictions registered before the runs (fact:predictions-for-the-recall-pilot-after-the-cues-registered-before-the-runs-2026-10-30). Same corpus, prompts and key as the pilot; published reflow2 0.94.0; fresh Sonnet per round; blind Opus scoring (labels K/M/N, mapping kept in scratchpad recall-key/blind4-mapping.txt; sheet recall-key/scores-after.tsv).
SCORES (/25, cites /25): full-design answerer 25 (25 cites; pilot 25). 12 KB with the kit's session-start cue 16 (13 cites): current-value 8/8, sums 3/3, contradictions 2/4, what-breaks-if 2.5/5, why-questions 0.5/5. 12 KB uncued 3 (0 cites; pilot 5.5). Pilot comparators at 12 KB: notes 14.5, reflow2 with a hand-written cue 17.5.
PREDICTIONS: P1 (full >= 24) HELD. P2 (in-reply cues followed within 5 calls >= 10%) REFUTED: writers were offered 683 cues, followed 26 within 5 (3.8%; pilot 4% by a replay of the same rules) and 292 at all (43%); the offers are dominated by loop_hint/set_decision_status 167 (23 within 5), loop_hint/loop_status 162 (2 within 5, 162 at all), loop_hint/detect_gaps 97 and loop_hint/get_skill:detect-and-ask 75 (never followed), loop_hint/governed_by 31 (never). P3 (kit cue >= 14.5) HELD: 16, above notes, 1.5 below the hand cue. P4 (uncued <= 8) HELD: 3. P5 (full answerer reads graph_report_markdown within its first three calls) REFUTED: get_instructions, then graph_report (the long one), then 23 scan_nodes. P6 (structuring tokens within 25% of 1,082k) HELD: 1,157k (+7%). P7 (a current-state record that search "current state" returns) HELD: writers kept proj:quellmere.current_state (1.7 KB) and art:memory-guide (22.6 KB description); search "current state" returns the project first.
WHAT THE CUE DID: the kit-cued reader skipped graph_report_markdown (the cue's first half) and followed the second half: search_design "current state" twice, then get_node on the project (2.2 KB) and the guide (8.9 KB, cut at the budget). So the gain came from the writers' own state record plus the cue saying how to find it; the compact report the cue names first was used by neither 12 KB reader nor the full answerer. The kit cue's 16 vs the hand cue's 17.5 is one run each on two different designs, so the gap is within noise. Answerers at 12 KB lose the why-questions: a state record holds values, not reasons.
COST: writers 1,157k tokens; full answerer 154k; 12 KB answerers 54k and 57k; scorer 80k.
FOR LATER INCREMENTS: step 7 (tool surface from the counts) has its list: detect_gaps, detect-and-ask, governed_by never followed across 200 offers; loop_status followed only at the end of a round. The first-read cue's first half did not change what readers read first.
